title: Sussex University spin-out Universal Quantum raises over $100m to pursue a 'Quantum Silicon Valley'
key_facts: Universal Quantum, a University of Sussex spin-out, raised over $100 million
Firgun Ventures and DCVC co-led the round; others include EDBI, Invus, and Roblox founder Dave Baszucki
Company aims to build larger error-correcting quantum computers
Founded from research by Winfried Hensinger and Sebastian Weidt; trapped-ion blueprint published 2017
More than 100 employees on three continents
Applications such as drug discovery remain goals, not demonstrated results
quote_evidence: The company aims to build larger, error-correcting quantum computers capable of tackling problems beyond today’s machines.

Potential applications include drug discovery, advanced materials and more efficient energy systems, although these remain goals for the technology rather than outcomes demonstrated by the funding announcement.
why_it_matters_hint: Funding supports building bigger machines and a planned quantum hub in Sussex and Brighton.
notes: Exact date not stated in article.
